reasoning: This genuine version differs from the planted claim only in 17 later-event dates, and every one now matches its source. The 10 notices are dated 2017-03-29 to 2026-03-24, each continuing the EO 13694 emergency beyond April 1 of its year. EO 14144 is dated 2025-01-16 and EO 14306 is dated 2025-06-06. All quoted spans and hashes match the held bytes. The 8 clauses cover the order's text (sections 1-5). The OFR note ('Amends: EO 13694'; See EO 14144, EO 14306 and the 2026 notice) is addressed, and no held text revokes or supersedes EO 13757. Its statements about EO 13848, 13849, 13984, 14110 and 14117 match the held texts. Note for the human reviewer, not a defect: the claim follows the 2026-10-21 strike-and-insert ruling and records the section 1 clauses as continuing, amended, after EO 14144 restated the whole of section 1(a) of EO 13694. Whether that ruling reaches an amending order whose inserted text was later restated in full is a question the claim itself flags. I did not read the ruling, because it is not among the files named for this review.
